name: OptinMonster
summary: Popup, slide-in and signup form builder that turns site visitors into email subscribers.
best_for: small sites and shops that want popups, slide-ins and signup forms with ready templates, and who accept yearly billing
skip_if: you want to pay month to month, need exit-intent on the cheapest plan, or want a popup tool we have tested end to end
honest_knock: The first-year price is a discount: Basic renews at about twice the price and Growth at more than twice. Exit-intent is not on Basic or Plus. Monthly prices are not shown on the pricing page. We did not test it.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · per year, First-year price billed today on annual billing
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-14 on optinmonster.com/pricing, US dollars) OptinMonster sells four plans, billed yearly by default. Basic is $108 billed today and renews at $210 a year, for 1 site and 2,500 campaign impressions. Plus is $288 billed today and renews at $570 a year, for up to 2 sites and 10,000 impressions, and adds A/B testing and device targeting. Pro is $348 billed today and renews at $870 a year, for up to 3 sites and 25,000 impressions, and adds exit-intent, countdown timers and webhooks. Growth is $588 billed today and renews at $1,470 a year, for up to 5 sites and 100,000 impressions, and adds geolocation targeting, coupon wheel campaigns and eCommerce integrations. The page says all renewals are at full price and that every plan has a 14-day money-back guarantee. It also offers a free trial with 500 impression credits. It states annual plans cost 50% less than monthly ones but shows no monthly prices. An earlier read on 25 Oct 2026 showed higher first-year prices for Plus, Pro and Growth, so the first-year prices move.
